title: Give the frantic mind a mantra
summary: The mind that will not stay still receives a different center when the Guru gives the Lord's mantra. Let the Name interrupt the ten-direction scatter before it becomes another chase.
takeaway: Give the scattered mind one Name before it chooses ten directions.
lifeApplication: Before opening the next tab, message, or worry, sit for one breath and repeat the mantra with full attention. Let the Guru gather the mind before motion spends it again.

source.shortMeaning: The restless mind becomes quiet when the Perfect Guru gives the Lord's mantra.
source.lifeApplication: When attention scatters, receive the mantra as a center before chasing the next pull.

evidence.coreClaim: The restless mind becomes quiet when the Perfect Guru gives the Lord's mantra.
evidence.turn: The Guru does not flatter the mind's motion; the Guru gives it the Name that can steady it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before opening the next tab, message, or worry, sit for one breath and repeat the mantra with full attention. Let the Guru gather the mind before motion spends it again.
